DejaVuSansMono.ttf and DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf are vendored here so that
tests which synthesize OCR-able test images (shareholding/valuation-inputs
table fixtures) do not depend on a Linux-only system font path
(/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/...), which does not exist on Windows or
macOS and previously made these tests fail there with a hard OSError from
PIL.ImageFont.truetype rather than exercising the OCR pipeline they are
meant to test.

Source: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/
License: Bitstream Vera License (public-domain DejaVu changes; see
Debian's fonts-dejavu package copyright file for the full text) -- freely
redistributable, including in source form, with the copyright/trademark
notice preserved. Font content is unmodified from the upstream release.
